judge_reasoning: The ground-truth bug is about the parse→serialize round trip failing to preserve the distinction between empty-string and null systemId when a publicId is present. The agent instead diagnosed a different (though related) bug: missing SYSTEM keyword when only a systemId is set without a publicId. Both involve DocumentType.outerHtmlHead serialization, so the agent found the right method and subsystem, but identified the wrong specific cause and scenario.
